```yaml
name: pr-closer

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-stale-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Close stale PRs
        run: |
          # Get all open PRs
          gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls?state=open --paginate | jq -r '.[].number' | while read -r pr_number; do
            # Get PR details
            pr_details=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$pr_number)
            
            # Check if author is jdx
            author=$(echo "$pr_details" | jq -r '.user.login')
            if [ "$author" = "jdx" ]; then
              echo "Skipping PR #$pr_number (authored by jdx)"
              continue
            fi
            
            # Check if PR has keep-open label
            labels=$(echo "$pr_details" | jq -r '.labels[].name')
            if echo "$labels" | grep -q "keep-open"; then
              echo "Skipping PR #$pr_number (has keep-open label)"
              continue
            fi
            
            # Get PR creation date
            created_at=$(echo "$pr_details" | jq -r '.created_at')
            created_timestamp=$(date -d "$created_at" +%s)
            current_timestamp=$(date +%s)
            days_since_creation=$(( (current_timestamp - created_timestamp) / 86400 ))
            
            # Close PR if older than 30 days
            if [ "$days_since_creation" -gt 30 ]; then
              echo "Closing PR #$pr_number (older than 30 days)"
              gh pr close "$pr_number" -R ${{ github.repository }} -c "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity. If you'd like it reopened, please comment and we'll review."
            else
              echo "Keeping PR #$pr_number (less than 30 days old)"
            fi
          done
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
